blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Language modeling using Transformers has become commonplace despite their fixed computational depth and quadratic runtime with respect to input tokens. Recurrent models on the other hand offer linear depth but no parallel execution. In this work, we extend balanced-tree recursive operators from sequence encoding to autoregressive prediction, enabling all prefix representations to be computed with logarithmic depth and linear runtime. Our experiments provide an initial characterization of this model class, demonstrating robust length extrapolation and performance approaching that of ALiBi-based Transformers, highlighting its potential as an alternative architecture for language modeling.
blocks.zh: 使用变形器进行语言建模已变得司空见惯,尽管其输入符的计算深度固定,运行时间为四进制。 另一方面,经常模型提供线性深度,但没有平行执行。 在这项工作中,我们将平衡-树递归运算符从序列编码扩展到自动递归预测,使所有前缀表示符都能用对数深度和线性运行时间计算. 我们的实验为这个模型类提供了初步的特征描述,证明了强烈的长度推算和性能接近于基于ALiBi的变形器,突出了其作为语言建模替代架构的潜力.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The success of large language models (LLMs) demonstrates the power of learning from large-scale corpora for tasks including text generation, translation, summarization, and question answering ( Neto et al., 2002 ; Sutskever et al., 2014 ; Kalchbrenner and Blunsom, 2013 ; Brown et al., 2020 ) . Much of this progress has been enabled by the Transformer ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) , whose parallelism makes large-scale autoregressive training practical. During training, a Transformer computes { p ⁡ ( x i ∣ x < i ) } i = 1 N \{p(x_{i}\mid x_{<i})\}_{i=1}^{N} in parallel, but its computational depth remains independent of sequence length. Instead, the depth of recurrent models depends on sequence length ( Elman, 1990 ) , but conventional recurrence imposes a linear-depth sequential bottleneck. This motivates architectures that allocate more computation to longer sequences while retaining logarithmic depth and parallel computation.
blocks.zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)的成功证明了向大公司学习的能力,以完成包括文本生成、翻译、归纳和问答等任务(Neto等人,2002年;Sutskever等人,2014年;Kalchbrenner和Blunsom,2013年;Brown等人,2020年)。 这一进步大多由变形金刚(Vaswani et al., 2017)所促成,其平行主义使得大规模自转式训练实用. 训练期间,一个变形器计算 { p {(x i ∣ x < i )}i = 页:1 无效( x) mid x_{<i})\}_{i=1}^{N}平行,但其计算深度仍然独立于序列长度. 相反,重现模型的深度取决于序列长度(Elman,1990年),但传统的重现会强加一个线性深度的顺序瓶颈. 这激励了在保留对数深度和并行计算的同时将更多的计算分配到较长序列的架构.

blocks.en: Tree-structured recursive neural networks offer one direction toward this goal, but studies are typically limited to encoding tasks like sentiment analysis ( Tai et al., 2015 ; Chen et al., 2015 ; Zhao et al., 2015 ; Chowdhury and Caragea, 2023 ) . Applying these models to predict every autoregressive prefix would duplicate substantial computation, and developing efficient autoregressive variants remains an important open problem ( Ray Chowdhury, 2024 ) . Log-Depth Recurrent Units ( Pert et al., 2026 , LDRUs;) apply associativity-biased operators in an up-sweep over a balanced tree, demonstrating generalization on regular-language encoding tasks. However, the up-sweep produces a single representation and does not provide an efficient way to compute the representation for every prefix.
blocks.zh: 树木结构的递归神经网络为实现这一目标提供了一个方向,但研究通常仅限于情感分析等编码任务(Tai等人,2015年;Chen等人,2015年;Zhao等人,2015年;Chowdhury和Caragea,2023年)。 应用这些模型来预测每个自旋前缀都会重复大量的计算,开发高效的自旋变体仍然是一个重要的开放问题(Ray Chowdhury, 2024). Log-Depth 经常单元(Pert等人,2026年,LDRUs;) 将关联性偏差的操作员应用在平衡树上,以显示对常规语言编码任务的概括. 然而,高清产生单一的表示方式,并不能提供计算每个前缀的表示方式的有效方式.

blocks.en: In this work, we add the corresponding down-sweep to complete the Blelloch parallel scan ( Blelloch, 1993 ) . By reusing the intermediate representations constructed during the up-sweep, the down-sweep produces representations for all sequence prefixes in parallel while retaining logarithmic depth and linear total work, as shown in Figure 1 . This augmentation yields a novel work-efficient parallel procedure for training these operators to predict the next token autoregressively.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们增加了相应的下行扫描,以完成Blelloch平行扫描(Blelloch,1993年)。 通过重用在向上扫荡过程中构建的中间表示,向下扫荡在保持对数深度和线性总工作的同时,会同时生成所有序列前缀的表示,如图1所示. 这种增强产生一种新的工作效率并行程序,用于培训这些操作人员自动预测下一个符号。

blocks.en: We evaluate the resulting log-depth recursive models on three language modeling corpora of increasing sizes: Penn Treebank ( Marcus et al., 1993 , PTB;) , WikiText-2 ( Merity et al., 2016 ) , and OpenWebText2 ( Gao et al., 2020 ) . Our aim is to provide an initial empirical characterization of where these models lie relative to conventional attention-based approaches, while identifying promising directions for their further development. Our contributions are threefold: 1. We use the down-sweep from the scan to introduce a work-efficient parallel procedure for training log-depth operators autoregressively. 2. We provide an initial characterization of the performance of these operators on autoregressive language modeling across three corpora of different scales. 3. We evaluate the trained operators’ ability to extrapolate to longer contexts.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了三种语言模型的日志深度递归模型,这些模型的体积越来越大: Penn Treebank (Marcus et al., 1993, PTB;), WikiText-2 (Merity et al., 2016),以及 OpenWebText2(Gao et al., 2020). 我们的目标是提供初步的经验性特征,说明这些模式相对于传统关注型方法所处的位置,同时为进一步发展这些模式确定有希望的方向。 我们的贡献有三个方面: 1. 我们利用扫描后的下行扫描,采用工作效率高的平行程序,自动培训日志深度操作员。 2. 我们对这些操作人员在跨三个不同尺度的公司进行自递性语言模型制作方面的表现作了初步描述。 3. 我们评价训练有素的操作人员在较长的时间内进行推断的能力。

blocks.en: We use the down-sweep from the scan to introduce a work-efficient parallel procedure for training log-depth operators autoregressively.
blocks.zh: 我们用扫描的下行扫描 引入一个工作效率高的并行程序 自动地训练日志深度操作员

blocks.en: We provide an initial characterization of the performance of these operators on autoregressive language modeling across three corpora of different scales.
blocks.zh: 我们对这些操作人员在跨三个不同尺度的连体的自动语言模型上的性能作了初步描述。

blocks.en: We evaluate the trained operators’ ability to extrapolate to longer contexts.
blocks.zh: 我们评价训练有素的操作人员在较长的环境下推断的能力。

blocks.en: 2 Method
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: The parallel scan algorithm consists of an up-sweep followed by a down-sweep, as illustrated in Figure 1 . Given a sequence e 1 , … , e N e_{1},\ldots,e_{N} and a binary composition operator ⊙ \odot , the up-sweep recursively combines adjacent representations along a balanced binary tree, storing the intermediate results. The down-sweep reuses these intermediates to produce an exclusive prefix representation h i h_{i} at every i i position. Although the classical scan assumes an associative operator, we do not enforce associativity; consequently, h i h_{i} depends on the balanced tree structure. When ⊙ \odot is associative, the produced representations are invariant to the tree structure.
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,平行扫描算法包括一个向上扫描,然后是向下扫描。 鉴于一个序列 e 1, ..., e N e_{1},\ ldots, e_{N )和一个二进制成分操作员 \\\ odot , 向上擦拭会沿平衡的二进制树将相邻的表示式相继结合, 存储中间结果 。 低温再利用这些中间体,在每个i位置产生独有的前缀表示h i h_{i}. 虽然古典扫描假设是关联操作员,但我们并不强制实施关联;因此,hi h_{i}依赖于平衡的树结构. 当\\odot是关联的, 产生的表示对树的结构是无变化的。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Up-sweep (dashed) and down-sweep (solid) operations on a length-8 sequence. Dotted arrows indicate next-token prediction targets. The up-sweep builds hierarchical representations, reused by the down-sweep to produce all exclusive prefix representations.
blocks.zh: 图1:按长-8顺序进行上行(dashed)和下行(solid)操作. 点箭头表示下一个点的预测目标. 向上擦音建立分级表示,由向下擦音重用,生成所有排他性前缀表示.

blocks.en: The up-sweep and down-sweep yield a structure of O ⁡ ( log ⁡ N ) O(\log N) depth and O ⁡ ( N ) O(N) number of operations where N N is the number of input tokens. Thus, we can compute all prefix representations with logarithmic depth and a linear number of operator applications, avoiding the linear sequential depth of a conventional recurrence and the quadratic runtime of Transformers, see Figure 3 .
blocks.zh: 上行和下行均产生O QQ(log QQ N) O(\log N)深度和O QQ(N) O(N) O(N) O(N)操作数的结构,其中N N为输入符数. 因此,我们可以用对数深度和线性操作器应用程序计算所有前缀表示,避免常规重现的线性顺序深度和变形器的四进制运行时间,见图3。

blocks.en: In our approach, the input to the parallel scan is the hidden representations of the tokenized sequence and the operator is a learnable neural network, ⊙ θ : ℝ D × ℝ D → ℝ D \odot_{\theta}:\mathbb{R}^{D}\times\mathbb{R}^{D}\rightarrow\mathbb{R}^{D} . Given token embeddings x ∈ ℝ N × E x\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times E} , we apply layer normalization, a linear projection, and a position-wise residual MLP to obtain hidden representations h ∈ ℝ N × D h\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times D} . After each composition, we apply layer normalization and a residual post-merge network. The scan produces h i h_{i} at every sequence position, which is projected to the embedding dimension and decoded using a tied token-embedding matrix. The model is trained using the standard next-token cross-entropy loss on shifted targets.
blocks.zh: 在我们的方法中,平行扫描的输入是象征化序列的隐藏表示,操作员是一个可以学习的神经网络,QQ:R D×R D− R\odot\theta}:\mathbb{R\D\times\mathbb{R\D\r\r\r\r\ rightarrow\mathbb{R\D}。 由于符号嵌入 x QQR N × E x\in\ mathbb{ R}^{N\times E},我们应用层态化,线性投影,以及位置偏移的剩余 MLP 来获取隐藏的表示h → R N× Dh\in\ mathbb{R\\N\times D} (韩语). 每次组成后,我们实行层态化和残余的后置网络。 扫描在每个序列位置产生h i h_{i},它被投射到嵌入维度,并使用绑定的符号嵌入矩阵解码. 该模型使用在转移目标上的标准次托肯交叉命中损失进行训练.

blocks.en: In our experiments, we parametrize ⊙ θ \odot_{\theta} as a Gated Recursive Cell ( Shen et al., 2019 , GRC;) . The GRC produces a gated mixture of a pair of states a , b ∈ ℝ D a,b\in\mathbb{R}^{D} . The two states are concatenated [ a ; b ] [a;b] , and passed through a two‑layer MLP. The MLP’s hidden width is 4 ​ D 4D with a 4 ​ D 4D vector output, which is divided into three gate vectors and one candidate: [ g a ; g b ; g c ; c ] ∈ ℝ 4 ​ D [g_{a};g_{b};g_{c};c]\in\mathbb{R}^{4D} , with g a , g b , g c , c ∈ ℝ D g_{a},g_{b},g_{c},c\in\mathbb{R}^{D} . The gates receive a sigmoid activation, and the operator’s final output is a gated sum followed by layer normalization: g ^ a , g ^ b , g ^ c = σ ⁡ ( g a ) , σ ⁡ ( g b ) , σ ⁡ ( g c ) , \displaystyle\hat{g}_{a},\hat{g}_{b},\hat{g}_{c}=\sigma(g_{a}),\sigma(g_{b}),\sigma(g_{c}), ⊙ θ ( a , b ) = LN ( g ^ a ∘ a + g ^ b ∘ b + g ^ c ∘ c ) , \displaystyle\odot_{\theta}(a,b)=\text{LN}\left(\hat{g}_{a}\circ a+\hat{g}_{b}\circ b+\hat{g}_{c}\circ c\right), where ∘ \circ represents element-wise multiplication. We refer to GRC operators trained autoregressively as AR-GRC . An alternative choice for ⊙ θ \odot_{\theta} is the associativity-biased MLP-LDRU operator of Pert et al. (2026) . In an ablation on WikiText-2 (see Appendix A.1 ), AR-GRC outperforms AR-MLP-LDRU, indicating that the non-associative g ^ c ∘ c \hat{g}_{c}\circ c improves expressive capacity.

blocks.en: 3 Experiments
blocks.zh: 3 个实验

blocks.en: Figure 2: Perplexity as a function of sequence length on WikiText-2 and OpenWebText2. AR-GRC and Transformer (ALiBi) both indicate adaptability to long contexts; Transformer (Sinusoidal) explodes in perplexity at long contexts.
blocks.zh: 图2:在WikiText-2和OpenWebText2上作为序列长度函数的迷惑. AR-GRC和变形金刚石(ALiBi)都表示适应长环境;变形金刚石(Sinusoidal)在长环境中会发生迷惑性爆炸.

blocks.en: We train our models on datasets of increasing size: Penn Treebank ( Marcus et al., 1993 , PTB;) ; WikiText-2 ( Merity et al., 2016 ) , and OpenWebText2 ( Gao et al., 2020 ) . We use SentencePiece tokenizers with byte-pair encoding ( Kudo and Richardson, 2018 ) , with vocabulary sizes of 8k for WikiText-2 and 50k for OpenWebText2. All models are trained on a maximum context length of 512 tokens. We compare against Transformer baselines with sinusoidal and ALiBi positional encodings ( Press et al., 2022 ) , since these directly test whether AR-GRC preserves autoregressive prediction under context-length extrapolation. We match parameter counts of the models and aim for 20M parameters on WikiText-2 and 100M parameters on OpenWebText2. For PTB, AR-GRC has 3.5M parameters and the Transformers have 3.8M. We provide further experimental details in Appendix A.2 .
blocks.zh: 我们用不断壮大的数据集来训练我们的模型: Penn Treebank (Marcus et al., 1993, PTB;) ; WikiText-2 (Merity et al., 2016) ; OpenWebText2(Gao et al., 2020). 我们使用带有字节-pair编码(Kudo and Richardson, 2018)的PriedPiece代碼器,其词汇大小为WikiText-2,OpenWebText2为50k. 所有型号都接受最大上下文长度为512令牌的训练. 我们比较变形器基线与sinusoidal和ALIBI定位编码(Press等人,2022年),因为这些直接测试AR-GRC是否在上下文长推断下保留了自递性预测。 我们匹配模型的参数计数,并瞄准WikiText-2上的20M参数和OpenWebText2上的100M参数. 对于PTB,AR-GRC有3.5M参数,变形器有3.8M. 我们在附录A.2中提供了进一步的试验细节。

blocks.en: Can AR-GRC models learn effective autoregressive next-token predictors across datasets and scales? Table 1 reports test perplexity for each model across the three corpora. On PTB and WikiText-2, AR-GRC is broadly competitive with the Transformer baselines. The test perplexity of AR-GRC is 7.5–13.1% higher on PTB, while on WikiText-2 it is 6.1% higher than the ALiBi Transformer but 3.8% lower than the sinusoidal Transformer. The gap is larger on OpenWebText2, where AR-GRC obtains 23.5–33.8% higher perplexity than the Transformer baselines. These results demonstrate that the scan-based architecture can learn comparable autoregressive next-token predictors across datasets and scales, although its relative performance declined on OpenWebText2, a larger and more heterogeneous corpus.
blocks.zh: AR-GRC模型能否在数据集和尺度上学习有效的自动递归的下一个预测器? 表1报告测试了三个公司每个模型的复杂程度。 在PTB和Wikitext-2上,AR-GRC与变形器基线具有广泛的竞争力. AR-GRC的测试复杂度在PTB上高7.5–13.1%,而在Wikitext-2上则比ALIBI变形器高6.1%,但比sinusoidal变形器低3.8%. 在OpenWebText2上差距较大,AR-GRC获得比变形器基线更高的23.5-33.8%的复杂度. 这些结果显示,基于扫描的架构可以跨数据集和尺度学习可比较的自动递归的下台预测器,尽管其相对性能在OpenWebText2上下降,这是一个更大和更多样化的元件.

blocks.en: Table 1: Test perplexity on PTB, WikiText-2 (WT-2) and OpenWebText2 (OWT2) for AR-GRC, Transformer (ALiBi) and Transformer (Sinusoidal). OpenWebText2 results are reported as mean ± \pm standard deviation over three random seeds; PTB and WikiText-2 results are from a single seed. Lower is better.
blocks.zh: 表1:对AR-GRC、变形器(ALiBI)和变形器(Sinusoidal)的PTB、WikiText-2(WT-2)和OpenWebText2(OWT2)进行测试。 OpenWebText2结果报告为平均±\pm标准偏差超过三个随机种子;PTB和WikiText-2结果来自一个单一种子. 低点更好

blocks.en: Do AR-GRC models generalize to context lengths beyond those observed during training? We evaluate next-token prediction on test sequences ranging from 32 to 2,976 tokens in increments of 128, substantially exceeding the context length of 512 tokens. Figure 2 reports average test perplexity at each context length for WikiText-2 and OpenWebText2. On both corpora, AR-GRC maintains stable perplexity beyond the training-length boundary, exhibiting behavior similar to the ALiBi Transformer. By contrast, the perplexity of the sinusoidal Transformer increases sharply once the context length exceeds 512 tokens. These results show that the tree-structured computation learned by AR-GRC can be applied to sequences nearly 6 times longer than those observed during training without a corresponding degradation in next-token prediction performance.
blocks.zh: AR-GRC模型是否将上下文长度概括到培训期间观察到的长度之外? 我们以128的增量来评价从32到2 976个信使的试验序列的下接预测,大大超过512个信使的上下文长度. 图2报告WikiText-2和OpenWebText2每个上下文长度的平均测试难度。 在两只蝎子上,AR-GRC在训练长度的边界之外保持了稳定的迷惑性,表现出了类似于ALIBI变形器的行为. 相比之下,当上下文长度超过512个令牌时,sinusoidal Transformer的复杂度会急剧增加. 这些结果表明,AR-GRC所学的树结构计算可以适用于近6倍于训练期间所观测到的序列,而不会在下一个预测性能中发生相应的降解.

blocks.en: AR-GRC does not rely on explicit positional encodings, which could make length extrapolation easier. The contrast between the two Transformer baselines demonstrates just how important the choice of positional encoding is for controlling extrapolation. While there has been recent work on Transformers without positional encodings ( Haviv et al., 2022 ) , their performance on language modeling is below the typical positional-encoding-based Transformers used here. Stable perplexity beyond training length demonstrates robustness to longer inputs, indicating AR-GRC is inductively biased toward autoregressive length extrapolation.
blocks.zh: AR-GRC不依赖明确的定位编码,这可以使长度推断更加容易. 两个变形器基线之间的对比表明,选择位置编码对于控制外推有多重要。 虽然最近有关于没有位置编码的变形器的作品(Haviv等人,2022年),但他们在语言模型方面的性能低于这里使用的典型位置编码基变形器. 超出培训时间的稳定性模糊性表明,对较长的投入是稳健的,这表明AR-GRC对自动递减的长度推算有必然的偏差。

blocks.en: How does AR-GRC evaluation time scale with context length compared with Transformer baselines? During evaluation, we record the wall-clock time required for batched forward passes at each context length. Figure 3 shows how runtime increases with sequence length for all models, but the observed scaling differs: both Transformer baselines grow quadratically, whereas AR-GRC grows linearly. The difference becomes increasingly pronounced at longer contexts, with AR-GRC running about 5 × 5\times faster than the Transformers at the maximum evaluated length for WikiText-2. The trends are the same on OpenWebText2, see Appendix A.3 .
blocks.zh: 与变压器基线相比,AR-GRC评价上下文长度的时间尺度如何? 在评价期间,我们记录了每个上下文长度分批前行通行证所需的时钟时间。 图3显示所有模型的运行时间如何随序列长度而增加,但观测到的缩放不同:变形器基线都四倍增长,而AR-GRC则呈线性增长. 差异在较长的上下文中越来越明显,AR-GRC运行速度比变形器在WikiText-2的最大评价长度上快约5×5\时. OpenWebText2上的趋势相同,见附录A.3。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Model per-batch evaluation time as a function of sequence length on WikiText-2.
blocks.zh: 图3:模拟每批评价时间作为WikiText-2上序列长度的函数.

blocks.en: This scaling behavior is consistent with the structure of the models. Attention computes a pairwise grid to model interactions between sequence positions, while AR-GRC applies ⊙ θ \odot_{\theta} a linear number of times in the length of the sequence. These measurements suggest that AR-GRC becomes increasingly advantageous as context lengths grow, despite not consistently outperforming the Transformer baselines. Further speed improvements may be possible by leveraging existing research in parallel scan implementations, such as Merrill and Garland (2016) .
blocks.zh: 这种缩放行为符合模型的结构. 注意计算成对的网格,以模型化序列位置之间的相互作用,而AR-GRC应用QQ\odot\theta}序列长度的线性次数. 这些测量表明,随着环境长度的增长,AR-GRC变得日益有利,尽管转型者基线的表现并非一贯高于后者。 通过利用现有的研究进行平行扫描,例如Merrill和Garland(2016年),可以进一步提高速度。

blocks.en: 4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: These results provide the first evidence that balanced-tree recursive operators can be trained as practical autoregressive next-token predictors using a work-efficient parallel procedure. AR-GRC achieves perplexities close to established Transformer architectures on PTB and WikiText-2 and continues to learn meaningfully on the larger OpenWebText2 corpus. We therefore interpret these experiments as establishing the viability of this model class rather than identifying a fully optimized alternative to the Transformer. The performance gap motivates further study of the composition operator, model capacity, and mechanisms for selectively retaining relevant contextual information.
blocks.zh: 这些结果提供了第一个证据,即平衡-树木递归操作员可以使用工作效率高的平行程序,作为实际的自动递归的下位预测器进行培训。 AR-GRC在PTB和WikiText-2上实现了与既定的变形器架构相近的迷惑性,并继续对更大的OpenWebText2教程进行有意义的学习. 因此,我们将这些实验解释为确定了这个模型类的可行性,而不是找出一个完全优化的变形器的替代品. 业绩差距促使进一步研究组成操作员、模型能力和有选择地保留相关信息的机制。

blocks.en: The fixed tree structure used by AR-GRC could be a limitation preventing better performance. Information is repeatedly compressed through predetermined composition paths, whereas self-attention allows each position to construct a token-dependent combination of the preceding context. This flexibility may become more important as the complexity and variability of the prediction task increase. However, the present experiments do not isolate the cause of the gap. It could be that the OpenWebText2 result is a limitation of the current AR-GRC instantiation and not evidence of a fundamental limitation of log-depth recursive models.
blocks.zh: AR-GRC使用的固定树结构可能是阻碍更好性能的一种限制。 信息通过预先确定的构成路径反复压缩,而自觉则允许每个位置构建前一种上下文的以符号为基础的组合. 随着预测任务的复杂性和可变性的增加,这种灵活性可能变得更加重要。 然而,目前的实验并不孤立差距的原因. 可能是OpenWebText2的结果是对当前AR-GRC即时化的限制,而不是对日志深度递归模型的根本限制的证据.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We adapt log-depth binary operators to autoregressive next-token prediction by incorporating the down-sweep of the parallel scan, enabling work-efficient training with AR-GRC. Across the three corpora, AR-GRC learns effective autoregressive predictors and exhibits robust length extrapolation comparable to the ALiBi Transformer.
blocks.zh: 我们调整了日志深度二进制操作器,以便通过将平行扫描的下行扫瞄纳入自动递减的下行预测,从而能够与AR-GRC进行工作效率培训。 在三股股股权中,AR-GRC学习了有效的自动回流预测器,并显示出与ALIBI变形器类似的强力长度推算.

blocks.en: Our experiments explore only a small part of the possible design space. More expressive binary operators may narrow the remaining performance gap, while larger-scale experiments are needed to determine how AR-GRC responds to increasing model size and training data. Establishing whether these architectures exhibit scaling laws similar to those of Transformers is left for future work. Another avenue for future study is to determine the associativity of the trained GRC operator, since non-associative composition makes representations dependent on the balanced tree structure.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验只探索了可能设计空间的一小部分. 更多的表达式二进制操作员可以缩小剩余的性能差距,同时需要更大的实验来确定AR-GRC如何响应不断增大的模型大小和培训数据. 确定这些结构是否呈现出类似于变形金刚的缩放法则,留待未来工作。 今后研究的另一个途径是确定受过培训的GRC操作员的关联性,因为非关联性组成使表述依赖于平衡的树结构.

blocks.en: These results establish a viable alternative for autoregressive language modeling and motivate further study of this comparatively underexplored model class.
blocks.zh: 这些结果为自递式语言建模确立了一种可行的替代方法,并激励了对这一比较未得到充分探讨的模型类的进一步研究.

blocks.en: A.2 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: A.2 实验设置

blocks.en: We use the AdamW optimizer ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019 ) . The learning rate follows a linear warm-up phase followed by scheduled cosine annealing. We use early stopping with a patience of 10 epochs based on validation perplexity. We use a batch size of 32. There are no warm-up steps for PTB, 300 for WikiText-2, and 2,000 for OpenWebText2. We found that learning-rate warm-up improved performance. The vocabulary sizes are 1.5k for PTB, 8k for WikiText-2, and 50k for OpenWebText2.
blocks.zh: 我们使用亚当W优化器(Lohchilov和Hutter,2019年). 学习速率遵循线性暖和阶段,然后是预定的余弦反射。 我们使用早期停止 以10个世纪的耐心 基于验证的迷惑。 我们用的是32的批量尺寸 PTB没有热身步骤,WikiText-2有300个,OpenWebText2有2000个. 我们发现学习率的热身提高了性能。 词汇大小为PTB1.5k,WikiText-2为8k,OpenWebText2为50k.
